terminals.name: api-server
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; export ACESTEP_DEVICE=cpu ACESTEP_NO_INIT=true ACESTEP_INIT_LLM=false; uv run python -m uvicorn acestep.api_server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --log-level info
terminals.description: ACE-Step FastAPI server on port 8001 (CPU mode, models lazy-load on first request). Probe GET /health or open /docs for the OpenAPI UI. On a GPU host, drop ACESTEP_DEVICE=cpu to enable accelerated inference.
